name: parkouring
layout: x fastest, then y (map row, +Y = up in the source image), then z (slice, up); texel (x,y,z) at ((z*dims[1]+y)*dims[0]+x)

boundsMeters.note: source axes: x = map column, y = map row, z = up; origin = corner of source grid voxel (0,0,0)

sdf.source: exact 3D EDT of (profile > 0), full 512x512x64 grid, signed (negative inside), surface at half a voxel from the nearest centres
sdf.outsideCrop: treat as far / empty (distance >= margin*voxel from the occupied bounds, except at the grid floor/ceiling where the grid ends)
